pages.title: Kaluza-Klein Shard
pages.text: Kaluza and Klein noticed that general relativity in five dimensions, with one dimension curled up small, produces electromagnetism for free. Momentum around that hidden circle appears as electric charge. The shard has a faint static charge and seems to hum slightly when spun.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I first found these in the Bulk, among Brane Strider remains and derelict stations. Running bulk stone through Maxwell's Demon Sorter with helium, I could separate grains with momentum in the fifth dimension.

Made in $(item)Maxwell's Demon Sorter$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Kaluza-Klein Ore$(), in veins through the Bulk.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Brane Strider.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Brane Cosmology.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Compactification Lathe, Compactified Circle, Dimensional Singularity.
